description: Changes: sets the named rooms' housekeeping status to clean or dirty; never out of order, never inspected. No preview: the change is made when called. Sets up to 40 rooms clean or dirty, as PMS › Housekeeping does; the room's status log names the person's assistant. A room out of order is refused (return it to service in the PMS). Not out of order and not inspected: those stay with the hotel's staff. One of the two people the owner named. Needs the owner's sign-in.

note.description: Why, kept in the room's status log
